mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, status, version, credentials_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, real_name, email, phone, organization, department, remark, security_version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT role.role_code FROM sys_user_role user_role INNER JOIN sys_role role ON role.id = user_role.role_id WHERE user_role.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role.role_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( username, password_hash, status, version, credentials_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, real_name, email, phone, organization, department, remark ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, 0, #{credentialsChangedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{organization}, #{department}, #{remark} )
INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'ADMIN' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = 'ADMIN')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalUsers, COALESCE(SUM(role_rank = 3), 0) AS admin, COALESCE(SUM(role_rank = 2), 0) AS dataOperator, COALESCE(SUM(role_rank = 1), 0) AS researcher FROM (SELECT u.id, MAX(CASE r.role_code WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN 3 WHEN 'DATA_OPERATOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'RESEARCHER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS role_rank FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id GROUP BY u.id) classified
